candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record documents a patient with established SLE, speckled ANA (1:1280), positive anti-Ro/SSA, anti-Smith, and anti-RNP antibodies, who develops erythema multiforme-like target lesions with bullae and full-thickness epidermal necrosis on biopsy — the constellation that defines Rowell syndrome. C001 identifies only the SJS/EM-like mucocutaneous component without recognizing the obligate SLE serological context that elevates this to Rowell syndrome. SJS alone does not account for the underlying connective tissue disease framework required by the benchmark diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: SJS is a component/overlap feature of Rowell syndrome but does not capture the full composite diagnosis requiring the SLE background with specific serological markers (anti-Ro/SSA, anti-La/SSB or RF, speckled ANA pattern) plus the erythema multiforme-like eruption together defining Rowell syndrome

case_quality_flags: Rowell syndrome criteria met: SLE + speckled ANA + anti-Ro positivity + EM-like eruption with histological interface changes and full-thickness necrosis
Biopsy showing full-thickness epithelial necrosis is consistent with SJS/TEN-spectrum overlap within Rowell syndrome rather than isolated SJS
